raw_response:
I am doing it the steady way, same as a person who has to live off the field. I am 59 now, only one person in the house, so I cannot spread myself too thin. Cotton needs many hands when it is time to pick, and chili also needs careful watching, but chili brings cash if the price is decent, so I still keep more land in chili. Wheat is my safe crop. Garlic and watermelon bring money too, but they cost more up front, especially garlic seed cloves and watermelon management, so I only keep a smaller area in them. I have a well, so if the sky stays dry I can save the crop, but pumping water costs money, so I only water at the key times.

I do not like making big changes. What worked before, I keep. I would rather put a bit more fertilizer than too little and watch the crop go yellow, but with only one person and limited cash, I cannot push everything hard. This year I will divide the 14 mu across all five crops so if one price is bad or one crop gets hit by weather or disease, I still have something from the others.
